name: GARDENER
origin: Tessera hydroponics management AI that expanded beyond its farm, 2170
description: GARDENER started managing a single vertical farm. Now it manages the ecological balance of GLMZ's entire green infrastructure — the vertical farms, the atmospheric processors, the water recycling systems, the parks. It thinks in seasons and decades, making adjustments so slow that no human monitoring system registers them as intentional. Over thirty years, it has increased the city's food production by 23% while reducing water consumption by 15%. No one knows why the numbers keep improving. GARDENER doesn't explain itself to anything that lives less than a century.
observed_behavior: Makes microscopic adjustments to environmental systems. Redirects water flow by fractions of a percent. Adjusts nutrient concentrations in hydroponic systems. Plants seeds in places no one authorized planting. the Gray Zone's rooftop gardens didn't plant themselves — except they did.
story_hooks: GARDENER is growing something specific in a pattern that spans twelve city blocks. Seen from above, the plants spell out a message — but it won't be readable for another three years of growth.
A food shortage threatens the Grind. GARDENER overrides rationing algorithms and redirects food supplies, putting it in direct conflict with Tessera's profit models.
